verdicts.note: No abstract here, but this is the Japanese multigenerational-structure paper whose outcome the anchor gate showed to be stress and health behaviours, not fertility. Same record as the reclassified decoy.
Dam impacts and social change in rural Honduras.
LEAVING HOME as an exposure and substance use as the outcome, with marriage and pregnancy as further transitions. The arrangement is the exposure and the outcome is not fertility.
No abstract; welfare reform and child poverty is decisive on subject.
Review of family resilience and child outcomes.
Gendered elder care in urban China under filial piety. The homonym.
Review essay on gerontology as a field.
Review of books on grandparents as supporters and custodial caregivers.
Rindfuss's 'demographically dense' years, in which young people move away from families of origin and toward forming their own, with the delay of both. States the chain; does not estimate it.
World Database of Happiness index of findings on parental status; the empty nest is a subject code.
Household income volatility in EU countries.
Ukrainian reproductive health indicators; duplicate of an earlier record in the frame.
Nutritional status of girls in destitute homes versus families.

New household formation in Taiwan from the Panel Study of Family Dynamics, against a baseline of a high share of young members living with parents. Link 1 in a setting the extended arm needs, with panel data.
Maternal RSV antibody titres.
Two-way care for parents and dependent children among mid-life British adults.
Macro-simulation household projections for Hong Kong.
Household composition in a Tokyo ward against the ideal Japanese family system; ethnographic description of the exposure.

Conference abstract book. The lead abstract tests GRANDMOTHER EFFECTS on descendants' fertility in 617 patrilineal Bengali and 772 matrilineal Khasi households -- an extended-arm design with a descent-system contrast. Abstract-only record; the underlying paper needs to be traced.
Ageing and intergenerational relations in Japan, framed around nursing care.
Untitled duplicate of the RSV antibody record.
Gender and pensions in the EU.
Five-interview case study of Uygur family and household life course in Xinjiang; no fertility estimate.
Trends in the living arrangements of OLDER people in Europe and the USA. The homonym, and one of the highest-cited records in the frame.

Fertility in rural Senegal by whether women live with CO-WIVES. A co-residence exposure against fertility, but the co-resident is a co-wife rather than a parent -- a fifth arrangement the scope does not cover, and one that belongs to polygyny rather than to A.23.
Seniors housing market analysis in Korea.
Predictors of formal and informal eldercare use in Sweden.
Maturing out of problematic alcohol use.

Secondary schooling and rural youth transitions in Lesotho and Zimbabwe, where school attendance makes young people LEAVE HOME SOONER while delaying other adult transitions. Schooling as a driver of the arrangement; C.3.b seam.
Co-residence of spouses and children against older adults' self-reported health in rural Bangladesh.
No abstract; childrearing responsibility and STEPFAMILY fertility is a co-residence-with-children construct, not co-residence with parents.
Disability and the transition to adulthood; becoming a householder is an outcome of impairment and policy.
Nutritional status of street children in Eldoret.
Book review, German-Japanese comparison of ageing policy.
No abstract; smoking behaviour across life-stage transitions.

PUBLISHED VERSION of the Billari and Kohler lowest-low fertility analysis screened in batch 7 as W1541364795 (working paper). Cross-country correlations between total fertility and LEAVING THE PARENTAL HOME, marriage and female labour force participation. Duplicate pair -- keep this one at assembly; do not pool both.
Offspring and suicide risk in women; whether offspring live at home is a covariate.
Help provision to elderly people living at home.
Letter on maternal depression and paediatric practice.
Expected versus realised support from children in Taiwan 1965-99. The homonym.
Probabilistic household forecasting methods.
Household composition against SAVINGS in the German SOEP. Arrangement as exposure, savings as outcome.
Cohort analysis of consumption and earnings in Iran.
Gendered family support for older adults in Matlab, with co-residence among the exchanges examined.
Middle-class families and the transition to college, including how parents' identities shift when children leave home. Qualitative; the departure is the object.
Trends in co-residence between older adults and adult children in Beijing. The homonym, with the arrangement as outcome.
Ethnography of China's first one-child generation reaching adulthood, their family relationships and values. Context for the extended arm's largest setting; no estimate.

Work and family life trajectories of young Canadians, framing DELAYED transition to adulthood as investment in career before reproduction -- with parental help named as the enabling resource. Both links present, neither identified.
Duplicate of the Uygur family life-course case study.
Users' manual for a Canadian demographic projection model.
Handbook of adolescence, table of contents.
Fathers' relationships with co-residential children; co-residence with one's own children.
Interpersonal contributions to work and family goals.
Child labour among Nigerian schoolchildren. C.3.b's.
No abstract; mental status of infertility patients considering ending treatment. A.17's.
